message.content: {"skills": [{"category": "characterization", "trigger": "When evaluating a chest X-ray for diaphragmatic abnormalities or suspected mediastinal/diaphragmatic masses (e.g., lymphangioma).", "steps": ["Inspect the contour and position of both hemidiaphragms, specifically looking for asymmetric elevation (often right-sided) and scalloped or lobulated margins (often left-sided).", "Systematically evaluate the costophrenic angles and lung bases to confirm the absence of pleural effusion (no meniscus sign or homogeneous basal opacity), distinguishing this pattern from effusion-related diaphragmatic obscuration."]}]}
